themeDescription: Society security barriers, wrong doorstep delivery & GPS pins

challenges.title: Gated Society Guard Refuses Entry Without OTP
challenges.shortDescription: Facilitate quick communication between delivery partner and customer to clear gate pass OTP or lobby drop-off.
challenges.mission: Bridge the communication gap between strict society security guard, delivery rider, and customer quickly.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: The rider keeps calling me saying the main security gate won't let him in without an entry code. I already approved him on MyGate app! He refuses to talk to the guard! What is the problem?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: doorstep delivery without walking down 18 floors

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Wants customer support to guide the delivery partner directly.
hiddenObjectives: Call rider on 3-way conference to confirm MyGate passcode 4821
Ensure rider is permitted elevator access to 18th floor

challenges.title: Delivered Notification But Left at Wrong Flat
challenges.shortDescription: Check doorstep photo proof, direct delivery partner to retrieve bag promptly, or dispatch fresh basket.
challenges.mission: Check delivery drop-off photo, identify floor/flat mismatch (Flat 402 vs 502), and retrieve parcel or re-dispatch.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: My phone just dinged saying 'Order Delivered' with a photo of a blue doormat. I live in Flat 502 and my doormat is brown coir! Someone else in my building probably has my grocery bag right now!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting their groceries before neighbor opens them

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Looks into corridor and confirms bag is not outside door.
hiddenObjectives: Call rider immediately before leaving building complex
Rider retrieves bag from 402 and places at 502 with apology

challenges.title: Rider Pinned to Locked Back Gate of Tech Park
challenges.shortDescription: Guide rider to active 24/7 security reception gate and coordinate desk handover.
challenges.mission: Correct GPS map pin discrepancy, direct delivery partner to Gate 1 Visitor Desk, and ensure delivery handover.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Your rider is stranded at the rear service gate of Manyata Tech Park which has been locked since 8 PM! I gave clear delivery notes to enter via Gate 1! Can you please guide him to the front entrance?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: hot dinner delivery before midnight code deploy

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Shares precise navigation landmarks (turn left near HP petrol pump).
hiddenObjectives: Patch clear route instructions to rider app
Call rider and confirm he is turning around to Gate 1

challenges.title: Customer Ordered to Home Instead of Office Address
challenges.shortDescription: Check if delivery partner has left dark store, reroute if within delivery radius, or handle cancellation gracefully.
challenges.mission: Assess delivery status immediately, evaluate whether address rerouting is technically feasible, and offer solutions.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Oh no! In my hurry I placed my lunch order with my default Home address instead of my Office address 6 km away! The rider just got assigned—can you change the destination to Cyber City?!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: not losing money on food delivered to an empty house

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Admits the mistake honestly and asks for assistance.
hiddenObjectives: Cancel order before packing with full zero-fee refund so user can reorder from Cyber City hub
possibleSolutions: Zero-penalty cancellation with immediate wallet credit
Assisted reorder to correct office hub
